title: All Shapes
subtitle: Twelve outlines, one size, one turned
description: One quest per shape the format can name -- rounded, square, circle, diamond, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, gear, heart, tome, star and none -- all at size 56 so the silhouette is the only thing that changes, plus one turned square: the same geometry after the fix that made a turn rigid and fitted.

The shapes are drawn from arithmetic rather than from textures, which is why a click lands on exactly what is drawn and why the icon always fits inside the outline -- there is no second description of the shape for the hit test to disagree with.

Every one of them is a closed set of names a file may write. A name this build has never heard of draws the default instead of failing, because a client can meet a file from a newer server while a player is standing in front of it.

The tome is turned ninety degrees and the turned square forty-one, which is what the rotation field does: any shape can be turned, and the turned outline is what is drawn, clicked and fitted -- there is no separate set of turned shapes to keep in step. A turn is a rotation of the shape's own definition, fitted to the node with one uniform scale, so a turned node is never cut off at the node's edge and never stretched.
